a: Yazaalibwa nga 16 Ddesemba 1867 mu kabuga ak'oku lubalama lw'ennyanja aka Millisle, mu Disitulikiti ya Down, mu bukiikakkono bwa Ireland, nga ye mubereberye mu baana omusanvu ab'omu maka ag'Abapresbiteri agatya Katonda; kitaawe David yali musiisi w'emmere y'empeke. Essaala ye esinga okumanyibwa ey'obuto yali ey'okusaba amaaso ge amaddugavu gakyusibwe gafuuke ga bbululu — essaala Katonda gy'ataddamu. Wabula emyaka mingi oluvannyuma, ng'asiiga olususu lwe langi enzirugavu asobole okuyingira mu masabo g'Abahindu awatali kutegeerwa mu bukiikaddyo bwa Buyindi, we yandimanyidde lwaki amaaso amaddugavu gaali kirabo ekisinga obulungi.

q: Okukkiriza kwe kwazibuwa kutya nga tannagenda mu nnimiro ya buminsani?
a: Mu Belfast yatandika okukuŋŋaanya abawala abasinga obwavu abaakolanga mu makolero — "shawlies," abaali abaavu ennyo okugula enkufiira — olw'amasomo aga Ssande, okutuusa omulimu lwe gwetaaga "Welcome Hall" yaagwo, eyazimbibwa mu 1887. Emyaka egyo gyaliko ekisiikirize ky'okufa kwa kitaawe n'okulumbibwa okw'olubereberye okw'obulwadde bw'olusi obw'olubeerera obwandimuyigganyizza obulamu bwe bwonna, era wakati mu kubonaabona okwo we yasooka okuwulira okuyitibwa eri obuweereza bw'obuminsani, ng'ayita mu Keswick okuyingira mu kuyitibwa eri okwewaayo okujjuvu.

Ng'akwatiddwako Hudson Taylor, yasooka okwewaayo eri China Inland Mission, naye obulamu bwe bwasalirwa nti tebumala. Mu kifo ky'ekyo yaseeyeeya okudda e Japani mu 1893 — okuva eyo kwe kwava ekitabo kye ekisooka, "From Sunrise Land" — n'oluvannyuma n'amala akaseera akatono mu Ceylon, era mu Novemba 1895 n'atuuka mu bukiikaddyo bwa Buyindi wansi wa Church of England Zenana Missionary Society. Okuggyako okutuuka kwe, teyaddayo kuvaayo nate, ng'aweereza emyaka amakumi ataano mu etaano awatali kiwummulo na kimu eky'okudda awaka.

q: Kibi ki ekyakwekebwa kye yalwanyisa mu Buyindi?
a: Ng'atambula mu byalo by'Abatamil, yategeera empisa ya devadasi, mwe baazadde baaweerangayo abaana abato eri amasabo, abawala nga bategekebwa olw'obwenzi obw'eddiini wansi w'ekyoyo eky'obuweereza bw'eddiini. Akaseera akakyusa byonna kaatuuka nga 7 Maaci 1901, omuwala ow'emyaka omusanvu ayitibwa Preena, eyali adduse okuva mu ssabo, bwe yasanga ekkubo okutuuka ku Amy — emikono gy'omwana nga gikyalina obubonero we baali bamwokezza olw'okugezaako okusooka okudduka.

Yava mu kununula kwa Amy abaana kinnoomu, n'ekula okufuuka amaka agaakuŋŋaanyizibwa okumpi n'akasongezo k'obukiikaddyo bwa Buyindi. Teyandigikulembedde ng'ekitongole: abaana baamuyitanga si "mukyala" wabula Amma, maama. Yayambalanga saali, yatwala emmere n'empisa z'Ekihindu, era yawa abaana amannya ag'Ekihindu. Baali abawala kkumi na musanvu okutuuka mu 1904, kikumi mu asatu okutuuka mu 1913, n'abalenzi ne bagattibwako okuva mu 1918, okutuusa ebifo by'okulabiriramu abaana abato, amasomero, ebifo eby'okukoleramu n'eddwaliro lwe byafuula Dohnavur ekintu ekifaanana ekyalo eky'Ekikristaayo eky'ekyokulabirako.

Mu kusaba kwokka, enkola gye yayiga okuva ku Hudson Taylor ne ku nnyumba z'enfuuzi za George Müller: obwetaavu bwabuulirwanga Katonda, so si kusabibwa baawi — tewaali kukoowoola wadde kukuŋŋaanya nsimbi. Mu myaka egy'obwetaavu egya Ssematalo Ogusooka, paundi bwe yagwa n'ebbeeyi ne zeeyongera nnyo, Fellowship mu ngeri emu teyasigala nga yeetaaga; obujulizi bwa Amy bwali bwangu era obutanyeenyezebwa — baali tebabuzeeko kintu kimu ekirungi.

q: Kuziyizibwa na nnaku ki bye yasanga?
a: Tewali kintu kikwata ku mulimu ekyali kya bukuumi. Yalumirizibwa okuwamba abaana, n'atwalibwa mu nsonga z'amateeka, n'aziyizibwa abo abaali basuubula abaana be yali akomya, era yaziika abaana be yali alwaniridde okulokola. Omwaka 1912 gwali gumu ku gy'ennaku ennyingi mu bulamu bwe, nga guleeta okufa kwa banne be yali akolagana nabo ennyo ne kwa maama we yennyini. Ekitabo kye "Things as They Are" kyanyeenya nnyo abasomi Abangereza olw'obwesimbu bwakyo obutaliimu bya kwesiimisa, abamu ne bamulumiriza okwongeza ku bintu.

Mu 1931 yasaba Katonda akole kyonna mu ye ekyandimufudde omusaanidde okumuweereza, era oluvannyuma lwa katono, ng'anoonya ettaka eppya, n'agwa okugwa okw'amaanyi ennyo — ng'amenya okugulu, ng'aggya ekinyiro ky'akakongovvule mu kifo, era ng'alumya omugongo. Ebiwundu ebyo, nga byegasse ku busannyalazo bw'ennyingo n'obulwadde obukadde obw'olusi, byamuleka kumpi ng'agalamidde ku kitanda okumala emyaka amakumi abiri egy'oluvannyuma egy'obulamu bwe. Okuva mu kisenge ekyo, mu bulumi obutakoma, yawandiika ebisinga ku bitabo bye amakumi asatu mu bitaano.

Lwe lukalala lw'ennyiriri ez'okukebera omutima, buli lumu nga lupima omusomi eri okwagala okwalagibwa ku Kalvale: "Bwe siba na kusaasira eri muweereza munnange nga Mukama wange bwe yansaasira, kale simanyi kintu ku kwagala kwa Kalvale." Ennyiriri ezo tezaawandiikibwa okuva ewala mu bweyagaze, wabula okuva ku kitanda eky'obulumi, omukazi eyali amaze emyaka amakumi asatu ng'ayiwa okusaasira ku baasuulibwa, ng'akebera omwoyo gwe yennyini n'obukambwe nga ogw'omusomi yenna.

q: Yafa atya, era kiki kye yaleka emabega?
a: Yafiira mu Dohnavur nga 18 Jaanwali 1951, ng'aweza emyaka kinaana mu esatu, ng'asabye nti tewali jjinja liteekebwe ku ntaana ye; abaana ne bateeka ekyoga ky'ennyonyi waggulu w'ekifo n'ekigambo kimu ng'ekijjukizo — Amma. Mu 1948 okuweebwayo kw'abawala eri amasabo kwaziyizibwa mu mateeka ga Buyindi, enkyukakyuka bangi gye bakwataganya n'obujulizi bwe obw'ebbanga eddene. Fellowship gye yatandika ekyagenda mu maaso mu Tamil Nadu, era yaleka olubaawo lw'ebitabo ku kwewaayo — "Obulamu bw'obuminsani," bwe yawandiika, "mukisa gwokka ogw'okufa."
